importBoundaries.reason: Core stays portable: no T3 types, no filesystem, no environment, no ambient clock. Digests and timestamps are inputs, not side effects.

Only the T3 adapter may know that T3 exists. The one exception is @t3tools/shared/nodeSqliteClient, a generic node:sqlite port of the Effect SQL client with no T3 domain in it; the plan says to reuse the repository's SQLite conventions rather than vendor a second copy.
